data.body_html:
Combine the thrill of deep-sea fishing with the romance of a sunset cruise on a single Marbella charter. Our Marbella fishing and sunset combo charter 2030 gives you two hours of angling in the rich waters off the Costa del Sol, followed by a chilled cruise as the sun melts into the Mediterranean. You’ll depart from Puerto Banús, catch bonito, tuna or dorado, then sip cava while passing Marbella Marina, the Golden Mile and the coves of Cabopino. All aboard the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, with a licensed skipper, full drinks and snacks included. Prices start at €749 for the 2-hour trip.

How the Combo Works

Your charter begins at Puerto Banús, where you meet your skipper and board your chosen boat. The first 2 hours are dedicated to fishing, with all tackle, bait and lures provided. Your skipper knows the best spots near Cabopino and Cala del Faro, where tuna and bream run. After the catch, you clean up and transition to sunset mode: the boat cruises west along the coast, stopping for photos and swimming if you wish. Unlimited drinks — cava, white wine, beer and soft drinks — are served as the sky turns orange and pink.

Boats for This Charter

We offer two boats for this experience, both departing from Puerto Banús and priced the same:

Both include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance and 21% IVA. For larger groups, consider our Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starting at €4,719 for 4 hours — contact us via WhatsApp for availability.

Fishing in Marbella: What to Expect

The waters off Marbella are part of the Alboran Sea, rich in pelagic species. From June to October, you’re likely to hook Atlantic bonito, skipjack tuna, dorado and mackerel. In spring and autumn, bream and sea bass are common. Your skipper handles all the gear — rods, reels, bait and lures — and will clean and fillet your catch. You can take it back to your hotel or a local restaurant for cooking. No fishing license is needed.

The Sunset Cruise Route

After fishing, the boat turns west. You’ll cruise past the luxury yachts of Puerto Banús, then along the Golden Mile towards Marbella Marina. As the sun drops behind La Concha mountain, the light on the water is spectacular. The skipper may stop for a swim at Cala Cortés or Cala del Faro. You’ll return to port around 20:00, having watched the sunset from the best seat in the house — the deck of a private boat.

What’s Included

  • Licensed English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel and all mooring fees
  • Fishing tackle, bait and lures
  • Catch cleaning and filleting
  • Unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine and cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, nuts)
  • Insurance and 21% IVA
  • Towel and sun cream on request

Why Book This Combo?

Most Marbella charters offer either fishing or sunset cruising. This combo gives you both in one efficient trip, saving time and money. You don’t need to choose between an adrenaline-filled afternoon and a relaxing evening — you get both. It’s ideal for small groups of friends, couples or families who want variety. And because it’s private, only your party is on board.

How to Book

Reserve your Marbella fishing and sunset combo charter 2030 directly through our website or contact us on WhatsApp for last-minute availability. We recommend booking at least 48 hours ahead, especially in July and August. Payment is secure, and you’ll receive a confirmation with departure details. For larger boats or custom durations, just ask — we’ll tailor the trip to your group.
